query: This model's inputs just changed silently — flag it for review if my agent isn't confident anymore, but don't touch its description
expected_behavior: Records the input change as contradicting evidence via 'write --contradicts' rather than directly setting a status field
Runs 'govern' to compute the verdict from the belief (open-proposal / needs-review / auto-write) rather than hardcoding a threshold check
Explains that a genuine contradiction (open-proposal) sets agent.status=NEEDS_REVIEW and adds the agent-needs-review tag, while the mid-band (needs-review) sets status but leaves the tag alone
States explicitly that governance actuation never writes the model's own description or other owner-authored metadata, only its own agent.* properties and tag
Reads back the agent.status and tag state to confirm the flag was actually applied
